description: Search the Open Quantum Materials Database for DFT-computed inorganic materials by composition and/or constituent elements, with optional band-gap and thermodynamic-stability filters. Returns formation energy (eV/atom), energy above the convex hull (stability), band gap, space group, and prototype. Keyless. Provide at least `composition` or `element_set`.

band_gap_min.description: Minimum band gap in eV (exclusive). e.g. 0.5 to find semiconductors/insulators.

composition.description: Exact composition, e.g. "Fe2O3", "LiCoO2". Matched as an exact stoichiometry.

element_set.description: Constituent elements the material must contain. Use OQMD set syntax: "(Al-O)" = contains Al or O; "(Fe-O),Ni" = (Fe or O) and Ni. A plain comma list like "Fe,O" is also accepted.

max_stability.description: Maximum energy above the convex hull in eV/atom (exclusive). 0 = exactly on the hull (thermodynamically stable / ground state). e.g. 0.05 keeps near-stable phases.

name: search_materials
title: Search Materials
